problem.title: LF-GICP KITTI Odom seq 07 full: elevation correction ablation
problem.question: Ablation: does the KITTI +0.205 deg elevation correction (used by upstream KISS-ICP and CT-ICP) change LF-GICP? The LF-GICP paper reports raw scans without mounting-angle correction, so the corrected variant is kept out of Table 6.

variants.label: paper_default (Table 6 variant on seq 07, raw scans)
variants.note: Voxel-normal localizability field gate + soft Fisher weighting on GICP scan-to-map (no GT seed; anchor matches first GT pose). mitigation=on beta=2 field_beta=0.25 degenerate_frames=13/1101 median_f0=0.200196 median_lambda0=0.020498
variants.readability_note: Uses the default CLI surface only.
variants.extensibility_note: No extra profile knobs beyond the stable core contract.
variants.decision_reason: Best combined benchmark score on the shared dataset and interface.

variants.label: paper_default (Table 6 variant on seq 07, raw scans) + KITTI 0.205 deg elevation correction
variants.intent: Same variant with the HDL-64E +0.205 deg elevation correction applied to every scan before downsampling.
variants.note: Voxel-normal localizability field gate + soft Fisher weighting on GICP scan-to-map (no GT seed; anchor matches first GT pose). mitigation=on beta=2 field_beta=0.25 degenerate_frames=13/1101 median_f0=0.19735 median_lambda0=0.0201897
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Useful for comparison, but not strong enough to replace the current default.
